title: Deflect (Rule 735.1.c) (rules_change)
old_text: Deflect cost paid once per spell/ability
new_text: Deflect cost paid once per time the target is chosen
explanation: Design team intended per-choice, not per-spell. Matters with Repeat and multi-target spells.
